scope: 4 KB-page Android 16 emulator native qualification of the Vulkan-wrapper candidate and its unpatched baseline using the offscreen probe: create image with caller-owned format list, upload/decode BC1/BC3 through buffer-image copy, read back pixels, and the read-only caller-data control. No app, APK, driver install or game run.

protocol.env: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<dir> PREFIX=<dir> WRAPPER_LOG_LEVEL=none WRAPPER_CMD_LOG_LEVEL=none FORCE_BCN_EMULATION=1 USE_IMAGE_VIEW=0

expected_controls.control: baseline readonly (caller-owned format list must not be written)

summary.note: Edge 4/5/16 and cycles 1/8; BC modes force the wrapper's emulation path because the emulator's native BC buffer-image copy is unreliable in this environment.

limitations: llvmpipe software Vulkan inside the Android 16 emulator, not Adreno/KGSL and not a physical GPU.
No Steam, Wine, window or game is started; no frame is rendered.
No performance/FPS measurement; cycles are synthetic synchronous probe iterations.
No validation layers; pixels are synthetic probe buffers, not game assets.
The wrapper is a build-tree library and is not packaged, installed or selected by Vapor.

The 16 KB AVD/API 37 results are separate (docs/evidence/2026-10-21-vulkan-wrapper-native-16k.json); this 4 KB pass was not repeated during the 16 KB session, and the two AVDs differ in API level and GPU backend, so no matched differential is claimed.
Raw logs and per-run artifacts for this 4 KB pass live outside the checkout at wrapper-build/native-probe under the Codex work directory recorded in docs/evidence/2026-10-21-graphics-source.json.
